title: Allahdad Massacre
text: The Allahdad was an 1839 pogrom perpetrated by Muslims against the Iranian Jewish community in the city of Mashhad, Qajar Iran. It was characterized by the mass-killing and forced conversion of the Jews in the area to Islam. Following this event, the Jews who stayed in Mashad began to actively practice crypto-Judaism while superficially adhering to Islamic beliefs.
